name: pr-completion
description: Autonomously prepare, review, repair, and merge in-scope GitHub pull requests through protected landing.

interface.shortDescription: Take pull requests through reviews and protected merge
interface.longDescription: Own the in-scope PR lifecycle through verified merge. Reuse one managed watcher, handle CI and review findings, rely on automatic incremental reviews, obtain effective approval, and land through GitHub protections under the original task authorization.
defaultPrompt: Use $pr-completion:take-pr-to-completion to take the in-scope PRs through checks, incremental reviews, repairs, and protected merge without repeated approval prompts.
